description: System 1 (laya) decisions and feedback from the ai_events bucket: answers, abstentions, confidence, latency, agreement with people and drift. See p4n4-docs, decisions/system1.md.

panels.description: Answers to the selected question in the time range
panels.title: Decisions

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "confidence")
  |> group()
  |> count()

thresholds.steps: Share of answers under the set's threshold: the caller got no suggestion

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "abstain")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> mean()

panels.description: Share of decisions whose caller used an answer
panels.title: Used

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "used")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> mean()

thresholds.steps: Of the answers System 1 gave (not abstained) and a person then confirmed or corrected, the share they kept

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_feedback" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and (r._field == "agreed" or r._field == "abstain"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "caller", "choice", "expected"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not r.abstain)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.agreed then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> mean()

thresholds.steps: As the caller measured it, network and queueing included. Keep it under half the caller's timeout

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: 0.95, method: "exact_selector")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.description: The set version of the latest decision
panels.title: Set version

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "set_version")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "abstain")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, choice: if r._value then "(abstained)" else r.choice, _value: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["choice"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: Share of answers under the threshold
panels.title: Abstention rate

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "abstain")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "abstained")

panels.title: Confidence distribution
panels.description: The confidence of every answer to the selected question; the set's threshold splits it

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "confidence")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: p50 and p95 as the caller measured them
panels.title: Latency

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.5, method: "exact_selector", column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p50")

from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_decision" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, method: "exact_selector", column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p95")

panels.title: Drift: last 7 days against the 28 days before
panels.description: Rerun the evaluation with recent feedback when an option moves by more than 20 points or the abstention rate doubles (system1.md §10.4). Ignores the time picker.

panels.title: Feedback: confirmed (rows) against answered (columns)
panels.description: From system1/feedback/<set>: every confirmation or correction a person made

targets.query:
// Confirmations and corrections: what people chose, against what System 1 answered
from(bucket: "ai_events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system1_feedback" and r.set == "${set}" and r.question == "${question}" and r._field == "abstain")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({expected: r.expected, answered: if r._value then "(abstained)" else r.choice, n: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["expected", "answered"])
  |> sum(column: "n")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["expected"], columnKey: ["answered"], valueColumn: "n")
  |> sort(columns: ["expected"])
